title: Offline Writes, Sync Queues, and Conflict Resolution Check

questions.prompt: What must happen before showing an offline bookmark as accepted?
questions.answer: Commit desired state and outbox atomically
questions.explanation: The intent then survives process death and can be synchronized later.
options: Commit desired state and outbox atomically

questions.prompt: Device wall-clock last-write-wins is always a safe conflict policy.
questions.explanation: Clock skew and domain semantics can discard valid edits.

questions.prompt: Why is synchronization designed for at-least-once delivery?
questions.answer: Retries can repeat an operation after uncertain outcomes
questions.explanation: Stable operation identity allows client and server deduplication.
